tagline: BUILDING CITIES, COMMUNITIES AND FUTURE VALUE.

story.title: Integrated property development at city scale — from townships to industrial ecosystems.
story.body: Sinar Mas Land’s portfolio spans township, residential, commercial, office, retail, hospitality and industrial development. Its industrial portfolio includes GIIC in Bekasi and KIIC in Karawang, positioning the group within Indonesia’s manufacturing and investment ecosystem.

highlights.title: Industrial ecosystems
highlights.body: GIIC and KIIC combine industrial land, infrastructure and large-scale manufacturing communities.

highlights.title: Integrated development
highlights.body: The portfolio extends across township, residential, retail, office, commercial and hospitality.

highlights.title: Green planning
highlights.body: GIIC is positioned around environmentally conscious industrial development and green infrastructure.

highlights.title: BSD City base
highlights.body: Sinar Mas Land Plaza in BSD places the group directly within Tangerang’s major development corridor.
